description: The authors list water-quality measurements, membrane characteristics, operational conditions and treatment results for water-recycling pilots in Tarragona, Rosignano, Nafplio, Lleida, Tain and Kalundborg. Described processes include ultrafiltration, reverse osmosis, membrane distillation, zeolite adsorption, photocatalytic reactors and nanofiltration. The collection includes regulatory comparison tables and pilot measurement summaries. Only descriptive lists were reviewed, so the current legal status of cited limits is not evaluated. A DOCX document holds the reported data; no raw machine-readable structure or independent sample count is established. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
